REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

  Service: Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice
  SDK: azure-ai-documentintelligence
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY

  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: process_document
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/document-ai/docs/processors-list#processor_invoice-parser

  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: analyze_expense
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/textract/latest/dg/API_AnalyzeExpense.html

  Service: Alibaba Cloud OCR invoice recognition
  SDK: alibabacloud_ocr_api
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: RecognizeInvoice
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET

output_text:
```python
from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential
import json

def normalize_expense(json_page_result):
    """
    Normalize Azure Document Intelligence invoice fields to a standard expense schema.
    Expected JSON_PAGE_RESULT format (example excerpt):
    {
        "invoiceId": "...",
        "vendorName": "...",
        "customerName": "...",
        "invoiceDate": "...",
        "invoiceTotal": "...",
        ...
    }
    Returns a dict matching the standard structure.
    """
    expense = {
        "invoice_id": json_page_result.get("InvoiceId", ""),
        "vendor_name": json_page_result.get("VendorName", ""),
        "customer_name": json_page_result.get("CustomerName", ""),
        "invoice_date": json_page_result.get("InvoiceDate", None),
        "invoice_total": json_page_result.get("InvoiceTotal", None),
        "line_items": []
    }

    # Normalize line items if present
    line_items = json_page_result.get("LineItems", [])
    for item in line_items:
        expense["line_items"].append({
            "description": item.get("Description", ""),
            "quantity": item.get("Quantity", None),
            "unit_price": item.get("UnitPrice", None),
            "total_amount": item.get("TotalAmount", None),
            "tax": item.get("Tax", None)
        })

    return expense

# ------------------- Azure Document Intelligence integration -------------------
def extract_and_normalize_expense_from_pdf(blob_contents: bytes, filename: str) -> dict:
    """
    Analyze a PDF blob using Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice model,
    then normalize the extracted fields into a structured JSON expense record.
    """
    endpoint = "YOUR_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT"
    key = "YOUR_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY"
    client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(endpoint=endpoint, credential=AzureKeyCredential(key))

    # Submit the PDF for analysis
    poller = client.begin_analyze_document("prebuiltdocumentintelligence/invoice", blob_contents, filename=filename)
    analysis_result = poller.result()

    # The JSON page result contains normalized fields
    json_page_result = analysis_result.analyze_result
    normalized_expense = normalize_expense(json_page_result)

    return normalized_expense
```
